2023_000_sep_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction register for Troy School District covering September 2023, printed 12/6/2023 and presented with the December 12, 2023 Board of Education materials. Each line lists a posting date between 8/28/2023 and 9/25/2023, a truncated merchant name, the journal-entry description SEP PCARD EXP, a budget unit, an account code, and either a charge or a credit. The register closes with a Subtotal of 379,773.65 in transaction amounts against 7,026.17 in credits, and Total Expenses of 372,747.48. The largest single charge is 12,000.00 to IN *MICHIGAN on 9/1/2023 in budget unit 700070399710100.
